title: Nourishing Dense French Beef Bisque
description: A cultured and dense French dish featuring beef stock concentrate, this quick-fix bisque is a perfect meal for any time of day, and is Jain-friendly as it contains no animal by-products except for the beef stock concentrate, which can be replaced with a vegetable stock for a fully Jain-friendly version.

ingredients.name: beef stock concentrate
ingredients.notes: can be replaced with vegetable stock for fully Jain-friendly version

instructions: In a large pot, saute the chopped onion, carrots, and celery in a little water until they are tender.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they are tender.
Add the beef stock concentrate, tomato paste, and water to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and let it simmer for 10 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the bisque until it is smooth.
Season the bisque with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
